patches.name: Add Boost Search bottom navigation
patches.description: Shows Boost's native Home, Search, Subscriptions, Inbox and Profile menu in Search and Go To.

patches.name: Add archive links to context menu
patches.description: Adds 'Open with Wayback Machine' and 'Open with Archive.is' to the link context menu.

patches.name: Anchor Boost Snackbars above bottom navigation
patches.description: Shows Boost Snackbars above the visible bottom navigation instead of covering it.

patches.name: Animate media in Boost gallery previews
patches.description: Plays GIFs and videos in Reddit gallery previews, following Boost's data saving settings. Tapping still opens the full-screen viewer.

patches.name: Auto-load next page after filtered results
patches.description: Loads the next page automatically when content filters hide every post on a page, instead of leaving the feed stuck behind a "Results were filtered" Snackbar.

patches.name: Automatically undelete Imgur images
patches.description: Loads deleted Imgur images from the Wayback Machine.

patches.name: Automatically undelete Reddit content
patches.description: Restores deleted and removed posts and comments from Arctic Shift, and their media from the Wayback Machine.

patches.name: Boost Morphe settings
patches.description: Adds a Morphe section and a reorganized settings screen with search. The classic settings stay available.

patches.name: Boost search default discovery
patches.description: Opens Search right away on a list of active subreddits.

patches.name: Custom Synccit URL
patches.description: Allows Boost to use a custom self-hosted Synccit API endpoint.

options.description: Full HTTP or HTTPS URL to a Synccit-compatible API endpoint, including api.php.

patches.name: Disable Boost Crashlytics startup network calls
patches.description: Stops Boost's crash reporting (Crashlytics) from connecting at startup. Other Firebase services keep working.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes ads from feeds and comments and keeps the ad SDKs from starting.

patches.name: Fix /r/all
patches.description: Loads /r/all through Reddit's .json endpoint so the feed shows posts.

patches.name: Fix /s/ links
patches.description: Opens Reddit share links (/s/) by resolving them to the post they point to.

patches.name: Fix Boost FAB nested scroll
patches.description: Hides and shows the floating action button in step with scrolling, also on pages with a collapsing header.

patches.name: Fix Boost YouTube playback fallback
patches.description: Opens the original YouTube link externally when Boost's legacy embedded YouTube player is unavailable.

patches.name: Fix Boost code block rendering
patches.description: Shows Reddit code blocks correctly and fixes links whose URL contains parentheses.

patches.name: Fix Boost comments Lemmy-style toolbar UI
patches.description: Removes the duplicate title above comments, keeping Boost's theme, toolbar title and sort label.

patches.name: Fix Boost image widget click target
patches.description: Makes the image widget open the post it shows instead of an older one.

patches.name: Fix Boost native image upload
patches.description: Uploads image posts and galleries to Reddit, and images in comments or text posts to Imgur, or ImgBB if you choose it. GIF and video uploads are unchanged.

patches.name: Fix Boost navigation bar overlap
patches.description: Keeps Boost's bottom controls and drawer clear of the system navigation bar on Android 15 and newer.

patches.name: Fix Boost target SDK 35 compatibility
patches.description: Makes Boost target Android 15 (SDK 35) and fixes billing setup on newer Android versions.

patches.name: Fix Boost video rewind back buffer
patches.description: Keeps the last 30 seconds of a video, so rewinding plays right away instead of reloading.

patches.name: Fix Hide crash
patches.description: Fixes crashes and jumps in the feed when hiding read posts.

patches.name: Fix Random subreddit
patches.description: Fixes the Random button by picking an active, non-NSFW subreddit through Reddit search.

patches.name: Fix Redgifs API
patches.description: Fetches a fresh Redgifs API token so Redgifs videos load.

patches.name: Fix download completed notification visibility
patches.description: Shows a visible notification when a download finishes, while progress notifications stay quiet.

patches.name: Fix missing audio in video downloads
patches.description: Fixes audio missing in videos downloaded from v.redd.it.

patches.name: Fix slow Giphy loading
patches.description: Loads Giphy posts faster by playing the MP4 directly instead of waiting for the Giphy API.

patches.name: Hook exception handler
patches.description: Catches Boost's crashes for debugging. Only enable this for development.

patches.name: Modify login WebView
patches.description: Adjusts the Reddit login page to prevent sign-in problems.

patches.name: Open Reddit image links in Boost
patches.description: Opens i.redd.it image links in Boost's image viewer instead of a web page.

patches.name: Prefer high refresh rate
patches.description: Requests a high display refresh rate for Boost on adaptive-refresh devices.

patches.name: Readable Boost flair labels
patches.description: Uses black or white flair text when Reddit's flair text color is unreadable on its background.

patches.name: Remove obsolete profile tabs
patches.description: Removes the legacy Gilded and Friends tabs from Boost profiles.

patches.name: Restore Boost sidebar Trending today
patches.description: Restores the sidebar's Trending today section, falling back to hot posts, and fixes its community limit setting.

patches.name: Restore GIF URL insertion
patches.description: Adds an option to the image menu to insert a GIF from its URL.

patches.name: Show end of feed
patches.description: Shows an "End of feed" row with a Refresh button below the last post when a feed has no more posts, instead of silently stopping. Home sorted by Best ends after a few hundred posts.

patches.name: Show inline Giphy previews in comments
patches.description: Adds inline media previews below Boost comment text for Giphy links and direct static image URLs.

patches.description: Restores functionality of the app by using custom client ID.

release_notes:
# Morphe patch bundle 1.4.123

### Infinity for Reddit+

### Changes

- Spoof client works again on Infinity+ 8.3.0 and newer: the billing step now finds the moved subscription prompt.

### User impact

Infinity+ 8.3.0 and newer can be patched with Spoof client again.

Issue: #252.

### Validation

- Final local release gate passed before publish.
- README SHA is aligned to the published MPP.
- Release tag: `morphe-patches-123`.
- Release asset: `patches-1.4.123.mpp`.
- Signature asset: `patches-1.4.123.mpp.asc`.
- MPP SHA256: `cee4fb7f7a084260c4a9a8a63b1decdfd4f6358b75d54f7d8990afba6e886eec`.
